name: Baracska (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Baracska (a red shield with a white building, with a helm, a crest and red and white mantling) above the name BARACSKA in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Baracska arms with helm, crest and mantling
